content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the House Keeping post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the House Keeping post at Narasapuram Area Hospital is scheduled for 10 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the House Keeping position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the House Keeping position is SSC (Secondary School Certificate). Candidates who have completed SSC are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the House Keeping role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the House Keeping post will receive a salary of Rs. 9000 per month. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the House Keeping post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the House Keeping post at Narasapuram Area Hospital. This is a direct walk-in recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the House Keeping recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the House Keeping recruitment involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Narasapuram Area Hospital. The exact address and reporting time will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contract-based job. The recruitment is for a House Keeping post on a contractual basis at Narasapuram Area Hospital.
